## Download

| System  | File |
|---------|------|
| Windows | `OBS-Backup-windows.exe` – just run it, no installation needed |
| macOS   | `OBS-Backup-macos.zip` – unzip, then right-click the app → Open the first time |
| Linux   | `OBS-Backup-linux.tar.gz` – unpack and run `OBS-Backup` |

`SHA256SUMS.txt` lists the checksums of all files.

OBS Backup backs up and restores OBS Studio profiles, scene collections (scenes and sources), settings, plugin settings and optionally the media files your scenes use. See the [README](REPO_URL/blob/main/README.md) for how to use it.

> ⚠ Backups contain your stream keys and passwords. Keep them private.

## Code signing policy

Free code signing provided by [SignPath.io](https://about.signpath.io/), certificate by [SignPath Foundation](https://signpath.org/). See the [code signing policy](REPO_URL/blob/main/README.md#code-signing-policy).
